purpose: Bind the terminal-swarm candidate's pre-data numeric design choices without treating them as empirical alpha evidence.

parameters.name: expected_move_cost_multiple_target
parameters.development_justification: A longer-horizon volatility-reversion repair is not worth prospective launch unless development-only signal-conditioned moves can clear realistic round-trip cost by a material margin. 2.0x is a pre-data hurdle, not an observed optimum.

parameters.name: entry_aggregation_lower_minutes
parameters.development_justification: The repair deliberately moves away from the prior very-short-horizon failure family; 15m is the lower boundary frozen by the candidate generator before Alpha Proof and must not be tuned using holdout outcomes.

parameters.name: entry_aggregation_upper_minutes
parameters.development_justification: 60m caps the candidate's entry aggregation within intraday scale while leaving the economic holding horizon multi-hour-to-days; it is frozen before development scoring and is not a best-horizon selection.

parameters.name: falsification_success_floor_pct
parameters.development_justification: This is a pre-registered falsification threshold only. It cannot promote the strategy during development and must not be changed after prospective outcomes are visible.

parameters.name: falsification_oos_days
parameters.development_justification: This is a pre-registered future falsification horizon, not an entry parameter and not a development selection variable; it remains frozen independently of candidate outcomes.

development_requirements: forward move, MFE, MAE and gross expectancy
development-only negative controls and feature ablations
failure_rule: If development-only evidence does not support economic feasibility, P3/P4 remain HOLD regardless of P2 provenance completeness.
